profile.headline: Software Engineer at Cisco
profile.summary: I am a freelance musician in the middle transitioning into a different career. I have always had a strong love of problem solving, so combining that with creativity would be the dream. Web Development is a great fit. All sorts of applications can be created by putting together the right pieces of code.

positions.title: Team Lead
positions.description:
- Manage a small group students as they work through curriculum
- Evaluate code and provide feedback in 1 on 1 setting
- Run stand up meetings
- Provide small assignments to help reinforce learning

positions.title: Freelance Educator
positions.description:
- Manage a studio of private lesson students
- Prepare for students for state wide music competitions
- Run small ensemble rehearsals and performances

positions.title: Graduate Teaching Fellow
positions.description:
- Run a section of a college level course
- Manage inventory of instruments
- Create syllabus and lesson plans
- Evaluate student's work

projects.title: How2
projects.description: This application allows users to create and consume instructional guides.

projects.title: Lambda Notes
projects.description: This was a simple project to that is designed to manage notes. I used the project to learn techniques to drag and drop elements in a React Application.
